market_story.title: Rate expectations continue supporting USD
market_story.body: USD and GBP remain supported, while EUR, JPY, and CHF stay under pressure.
drivers: USD: Rate expectations continue supporting USD
EUR: Weak growth data is pressuring the euro
GBP: Inflation is supporting the pound

narrative_focus.headline: Central bank guidance is in focus
narrative_focus.rationale: Central bank communication is the clearest calendar-linked theme.

macro_evolution.summary: CPI m/m is the next test for central bank guidance.

USD.label: Supported
USD.headline: Rate expectations continue supporting USD
reasons: The Fed is keeping rates high and has no plans to cut
The economy is performing well
The dollar remains the world's most-used currency
USD.invalidation: This view weakens if inflation slows or The Fed sounds more careful
USD.insight: Higher rates keep money flowing into the dollar

EUR.label: Weak
EUR.headline: Weak growth data is pressuring the euro
reasons: Europe's economy lacks enough momentum
The ECB is actively cutting rates
The economic data has been consistently weak
EUR.invalidation: This view changes if growth data improves clearly
EUR.insight: The euro needs stronger growth to regain support

GBP.label: Supported
GBP.headline: Inflation is supporting the pound
reasons: Inflation is keeping the BOE cautious about cutting rates
The BOE is keeping rates high and has no plans to cut
The economy is performing well
GBP.invalidation: This view changes if inflation cools faster than expected
GBP.insight: The pound still has support while inflation stays sticky

JPY.label: Weak
JPY.headline: BOJ guidance is in focus for JPY
reasons: JPY can react quickly when global risk sentiment changes
The yen is highly sensitive to sudden mood changes
The BOJ is actively cutting rates
JPY.invalidation: This view changes if global market mood shifts clearly
JPY.insight: Market mood is the key driver for the yen right now
JPY.key_event: BOJ Gov Ueda Speaks tomorrow · Medium impact

CHF.label: Weak
CHF.headline: The franc is driven by risk mood
reasons: Swiss stability matters most when markets become nervous
Swiss stability is steady in the background
The SNB is actively cutting rates
CHF.invalidation: This view changes if global market mood shifts clearly
CHF.insight: The franc needs a clearer shift in market mood

CAD.label: Neutral
CAD.headline: CAD is waiting for a clearer oil story
reasons: Canada is sensitive to oil prices and US demand
Oil prices and US economic health are the key drivers
CAD.invalidation: This view changes if oil prices or US demand improve clearly
CAD.insight: CAD needs a clearer lift from oil or US demand

AUD.label: Weak
AUD.headline: Inflation data is in focus for AUD
reasons: Australia is sensitive to China and global commodity demand
Commodity prices and China remain the key factors
The RBA is actively cutting rates
AUD.invalidation: This view changes if China or global demand improves clearly
AUD.insight: AUD needs a stronger global demand story

NZD.label: Weak
NZD.headline: NZD needs stronger global demand
reasons: New Zealand is sensitive to global trade conditions
Global trade conditions matter more than local data
The RBNZ is actively cutting rates
NZD.invalidation: This view changes if China or global demand improves clearly
NZD.insight: NZD needs clearer support from global demand
NZD.key_event: RBNZ Monetary Policy Statement tomorrow · High impact
